query: Hey, I just wanted to say I had the best iced lavender latte from the café down my street this morning, they added just the right amount of honey and it was so creamy I’m already planning to go back tomorrow. Oh and my rescue cat just figured out how to open the snack cabinet last night, I caught her halfway inside trying to steal a bag of tuna treats, it was equal parts impressive and annoying. Also I’m thinking of planting some tomato seedlings on my balcony this weekend, I found a really cute self-watering planter online that’s supposed to be perfect for small spaces. Anyway, I’m having an issue with my phone right now: my wifi calling is really bad, my data mode is turned off, and I got a notification that I’ve exceeded my data usage, can you help me fix this?
